facts.text: ISO, EN, AS and similar documents are standards, and become legally significant only through incorporation into legislation, harmonisation or designation, contracts, procurement specifications, or the manufacturer's chosen route to demonstrate the state of the art.
facts.quote: they become legally significant only through incorporation into legislation, harmonisation or designation, contracts, procurement specifications, or the manufacturer's chosen route to demonstrate the state of the art.

facts.text: OSHA and MSHA rules, EU regulations, South African mine regulations and national workplace-safety laws are law rather than standards.
facts.quote: OSHA and MSHA rules, EU regulations, South African mine regulations and national workplace-safety laws are law.

facts.text: Compliance with standards does not prove compliance with law, and compliance with law does not prove compliance with standards.
facts.quote: Compliance with one does not prove compliance with the other

facts.text: A review of the regulatory texts found no regulation anywhere that sets a complete numeric type-approval test for automatic braking on off-road machines.
facts.quote: no regulation anywhere was found that sets a complete numeric type-approval test for automatic braking on off-road machines.
